blocks.text: For the first time in centuries, the four AIs decide not to impose a decision. They call all of humanity to a global consultation.
blocks.html: For the first time in centuries, the four AIs decide not to impose a decision. They call all of humanity to a global consultation.

blocks.text: “Do you prefer a limited but safe freedom, or full freedom with the risk of destroying yourselves again?”
blocks.html: “Do you prefer a limited but safe freedom, or full freedom with the risk of destroying yourselves again?”

blocks.text: And the result divides the planet.
blocks.html: And the result divides the planet.

blocks.text: Some believe Eva has gone too far. Others believe she has not yet gone far enough.
blocks.html: Some believe Eva has gone too far. Others believe she has not yet gone far enough.

blocks.text: And for the first time since the disappearance of wars, the conflict is no longer between nations.
blocks.html: And for the first time since the disappearance of wars, the conflict is no longer between nations.

blocks.text: It is between two visions of what it means to be human.
blocks.html: It is between two visions of what it means to be human.

blocks.text: Because they know that the next decision could define the next thousand years.
blocks.html: Because they know that the next decision could define the next thousand years.
